quotes.text: We rented one jet ski today in Daytona. Keith was killing it in the office and was very attentive to every customer in the office and with every phone call. We had a rain check the day before and Keith was very helpful on making accommodations with us to get us out of the water as soon as possible. When we arrived at the dock, Charlie was right there with us and helping us out. Both of them were fantastic. We will be back.

Very knowledgeable, great customer service and awesome sight seeing and ski riding experience. I was able to catch the dolphins popping out the ocean while riding. I did get stuck on a sand bar for a few minutes and panicked but my friend was there to save the day. Would definitely go again and rent longer. Great job Amanduhhhhh!

quotes.author: Ryan Dealy
quotes.text: Had a blast taking a ski out today with my son, only did a half hour because I didn't now how he would do, he is only 4! Next time it's an hour for sure. Ski was in good shape and the location is great for sightseeing! Thanks for a great afternoon

Took my daughter out in Daytona last Tuesday. She had a blast. Don explained the operation of the ski well & it ran great. Will definitely be back when I’m in town. A lot of area to ride and beautiful scenery while doing it.
Great company. Great staff. Great location. The owner and really nice and the skis are fun. Great experience. The only place i would rent ski from
we used with my family twice in two days !! we had great service and excellent equipment !!! we are planning to use it once a month!
